name: Kitties on Planets
summary:
Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle!

The white cat can push supply boxes, causing them to keep moving until they collide with an obstacle. The black cat cannot push boxes, but can move the magnets scattered throughout the environment. These magnets attract boxes and the inactive character when they enter their range, allowing you to change their positions and create new paths.

Magnetic attraction works in a straight line and cannot pass through walls or other objects that block its range. Observe the environment, switch between the two cats, and carefully consider every move to prevent a box from becoming stuck in an unreachable position.
